cards.title: Equal-spacing Table-I coefficients

checks.reason: Table I prints the small, separate, braided, and nested coefficients used by Main Fig. 2.
Grouping equal pair distances in EQ002 gives the multiplicities 1+2+1 for aabb, 3+1 for abab, and 2+2 for abba.
All 13 visible curves are generated from these expressions over 0 <= phi <= pi at gamma=1.

cards.title: Decoherence-free braided interaction

checks.reason: The main text states the braided zero-decay/nonzero-exchange result and the supplement derives it as Eq. gBraidedAtoms.
Substitution into the braided Table-I expressions cancels all decay terms and leaves g/gamma=1.
At phi=pi, the separate and nested zero-decay points instead have zero exchange, matching the paper's topology distinction.
The frozen grid contains pi/2 exactly and the target check records the expected four values.

cards.numerical_form: Evaluate the frozen arrays at phi=pi/2 and compare against (g, Gamma_a, Gamma_b, Gamma_coll)=(1,0,0,0).
